question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP

decoded.body: {"statusCode":401,"message":"This endpoint only accepts an active CONSOLE key, but an invalid key was sent. Key: ","error":"Unauthorized"}
decoded.docs-mcp: POST initialize to https://docs.statsig.com/api/mcp with no key answers 200

finding: Statsig's product MCP server refuses an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and says in the body that the endpoint accepts only an active Console key; the Console REST API answers 401 keyless as well. The documentation MCP server at docs.statsig.com/api/mcp answers 200 to the same keyless initialize, so the vendor runs one open surface and one closed one under the same brand, and an entry that records a single access answer for Statsig is recording the wrong thing. Measured three times now (2026-09-09, 2026-09-17 06:00Z, 2026-09-17 12:14Z) with the same result. No credential was sent, so nothing here measures what the product server does with one.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -i -X POST https://api.statsig.com/v1/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"public-agents-researcher","version":"1.0"}}}'
